account-locked: Wɔasiw akontaabu no kwan bere tiaa bi efisɛ mmɔden a wɔabɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ mu a ayɛ huammɔ no dɔɔso dodo. San sɔ hwɛ akyiri yi.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel no yɛ SuperAdmin nko ara dea, wɔ Cloud Panel Domain no so.
cloud-settings-desc: Sɛ WeKan wɔ Weddy mu a, Cloud Panel no som WeKan domain pii fi server baako so, na emu biara wɔ ne data. Wɔ Cloud Panel Domain no so, SuperAdmin no hwɛ domain no ne CloudFlare so.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Sɛ wowɔ CloudFlare API safe a, domain a ne zone wɔ wo CloudFlare account mu no nya DNS record a ɛfa proxy so ne CloudFlare Origin krataa. Domain afoforo nya Let's Encrypt krataa. Wɔde safe no sie server no so na wɔnkyerɛ bio da.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Wɔnkoraa CloudFlare API safe biara: domain biara nya Let's Encrypt krataa.
error-ldap-login: Mfomso bi sii bere a na wɔrepɛ sɛ wɔkɔ mu
error-notAuthorized: Wunni kwan sɛ wobɛhwɛ kratafa yi.
